description: The published monthly gross pay for hospital doctors in Germany, step by step, from the tariff's own table: TV-Ärzte/VKA (municipal hospitals), TV-Ärzte TdL (university hospitals), Helios, Asklepios, Sana, Rhön, BG Kliniken and Charité. Each answer names the table's valid-from date, its source document and the day Klaro read it. A tariff Klaro has no checked table for is answered as such, never estimated.

group.description: Pay group: assistenzarzt (Ä1), facharzt (Ä2) or oberarzt (Ä3). Left out: all three.

tariff.description: Tariff key or name: vka, tdl, helios, asklepios, sana, rhoen, bg, charite ("TV-Ärzte/VKA", "Uniklinik" and "kommunal" also work).

year.description: Year in the pay group as the table counts it (1 = first year as Assistenzarzt, Facharzt or Oberarzt), for the pay in that year. Not a calendar year.
